messages.content: Help me send a 'submit' action to a React form with the ID 'loginForm' at a coordinate that is 30% from the top and 60% from the left?

function.name: submitAtCoordinate
function.description: This function sends a submit action to a React form element at a specific position determined by coordinates relative to its bounding box. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

action.description: The type of action to send. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

formId.description: The ID of the React form element to which to send the action. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

coordinates.description: An array of two numbers representing the x and y coordinates relative to the element's bounding box in the format of [x,y], in percentages. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type float; they are not in string representation.
